cover.kicker: 封面故事 · 社区热议
cover.title:
REA 日增近六千星
争议让它再涨百万浏览
cover.dek: morluto/rea 日增 +5,896 连续第二天居榜首,今天的话题转向「Anthropic 是否限制了逆向能力」。两条帖子合计 👁1,067,130,不过「限制」只是网友转述,并无官方确认。
cover.title_en:
REA Adds Nearly 6,000 Stars a Day
As a Restriction Row Draws a Million Views
cover.dek_en: morluto/rea topped the chart for a second day at +5,896 stars. The chatter has shifted to whether Anthropic restricted reverse engineering: two posts drew 1,067,130 views, though the claim is hearsay with no official confirmation.

stickers.title: 安全新势
stickers.text: cloudflare/security-audit-skill 日增 +2,744,高于昨天的 +2,177,连续两天排在增速第二。
stickers.text_en: cloudflare/security-audit-skill gained +2,744 stars, up from +2,177 yesterday, and is second in growth for the second straight day.

stickers.title: 论文角
stickers.text: Self-Evolving Agent Harness 获 👍99,让脚手架在固定权重下自我演化,成为论文区最热主题。
stickers.text_en: Self-Evolving Agent Harness drew 👍99 by letting scaffolding evolve with fixed weights, the hottest theme in papers today.

stickers.title: 叠加缩水
stickers.text: RAG 组合评测显示,单点有效的技术叠加后,预测提升 +47%,实测只有 +17%。
stickers.text_en: A RAG composition study found techniques that work alone stack poorly: a predicted +47% gain came out at just +17%.
